quizName: DP-600 Practice Exam 3 - Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate

questions.Question: You are developing a semantic model that contains more than 100 measures. For each measure, you must provide Month-to-Date, Year-to-Date, and Year-over-Year calculations. You need to minimize ongoing maintenance effort. What should you do?

Options.text: Create separate DAX measures for every time-intelligence variation
Options.reason: Incorrect. This creates a large number of measures and increases maintenance.
Correct. Calculation groups allow reusable logic across many measures.

Options.text: Store all calculations in Dataflow Gen2
Options.reason: Incorrect. Dataflow Gen2 transformations do not replace semantic model calculations.
Incorrect. Calculated columns are not appropriate for reusable time intelligence.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Calculation groups centralize common calculation logic and significantly reduce the number of measures that must be created and maintained.

questions.Question: Two analytics engineers need to work simultaneously on different parts of the same Power BI solution while maintaining version history. Which approach should you recommend?

Options.text: Use Power BI Project (PBIP) files with Git version control
Options.reason: Correct. PBIP stores project components as files that can be version controlled.
Incorrect. This creates version conflicts.

Options.text: Store a single PBIX file in a shared folder
Options.reason: Incorrect. Concurrent development is limited.

Options.text: Export reports to PDF before making changes
Options.reason: Incorrect. PDFs do not support collaborative development.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: PBIP combined with Git enables collaborative development, branching, version history, and source control.

questions.Question: A workspace must be integrated with Azure DevOps to provide code reviews, change tracking, and version control for Fabric artifacts. Which workspace feature should you enable?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Workspace Identity manages authentication scenarios.
Incorrect. This controls connectivity.
Correct. Git integration provides source control and lifecycle management.
Incorrect. Spark settings control compute behavior.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Git integration enables Azure DevOps integration, change history, branching, and version control.

questions.Question: You plan to rename a column in a certified semantic model that is used by multiple reports. You need to identify downstream dependencies before making the change. What should you use?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Dataflows do not provide dependency analysis.
Incorrect. SQL endpoints do not display report dependencies.
Incorrect. Notebooks do not provide complete semantic model dependency tracking.
Correct. Lineage view displays upstream and downstream dependencies.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Data lineage view helps identify reports, datasets, and workspaces affected by changes.

questions.Question: Report authors need a reusable file that includes branding, standard layouts, and predefined visuals but contains no embedded data. What should you create?

Options.reason: Correct. PBIT files store report definitions without embedded data.
Incorrect. PBIX files contain data.
Incorrect. PBIDS files only store connection information.
Incorrect. CSV files do not store report layouts.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: PBIT files are specifically designed for reusable report templates without embedded data.

questions.topic: Implement and manage data analytics solutions
questions.Question: You must ingest 500 million rows from Azure SQL Database into a Fabric lakehouse. No transformations are required. Which option provides the best balance of performance and operational simplicity?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Dataflow Gen2 is better suited for transformation scenarios.
Correct. Copy activity is optimized for high-volume ingestion.
Incorrect. Notebooks add unnecessary complexity.
Incorrect. This is inefficient for very large datasets.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Copy activity is the recommended method for large-scale ingestion when transformations are not required.

questions.topic: Implement and manage data analytics solutions
questions.Question: You need to ingest data from multiple Azure storage accounts into a Fabric warehouse using a code-centric approach that supports high throughput. Which option should you use?

Options.reason: Correct. COPY is optimized for high-throughput warehouse ingestion.
Incorrect. Dataflow Gen2 is intended for transformation scenarios.
Incorrect. Eventstreams target streaming workloads.
Incorrect. Refreshes do not perform warehouse ingestion.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: COPY provides efficient, high-throughput ingestion into Fabric warehouses.

questions.topic: Implement and manage data analytics solutions
questions.Question: A data pipeline must execute daily at midnight UTC regardless of the workspace region. Where should you configure the time zone?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Warehouse schedules do not control pipeline execution.
Correct. Pipelines have their own time zone configuration.
Incorrect. These apply only to semantic model refreshes.
Incorrect. Pipeline schedules are configured independently.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Pipeline schedules include a dedicated time-zone setting that controls execution timing.

questions.topic: Implement and manage data analytics solutions
questions.Question: A Dataflow Gen2 query filters data after applying a transformation that breaks query folding. Performance is poor. What should you do first?

Options.text: Move the filter step before the transformation
Options.reason: Correct. Filtering early can preserve query folding.
Incorrect. Table.Buffer can prevent folding.
Incorrect. DAX is not used for ingestion transformations.
Incorrect. This does not restore query folding.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Applying filters before folding-breaking transformations allows the source system to perform filtering.

questions.topic: Implement and manage data analytics solutions
questions.Question: You experience timeout issues in a Dataflow Gen2 solution containing many transformations. Query optimization has already been completed. What should you recommend?

Options.text: Replace the dataflow with a semantic model
Options.reason: Incorrect. Semantic models do not perform ingestion.

Options.text: Move the destination to a warehouse
Options.reason: Incorrect. This alone may not resolve timeouts.

Options.text: Create a staging dataflow and a second transformation dataflow
Options.reason: Correct. Separating ingestion and transformation is a recommended practice.
Incorrect. This would typically worsen performance.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: A staged architecture reduces complexity and helps avoid timeout issues.

questions.topic: Implement and manage data analytics solutions
questions.Question: You need to ingest data from Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 into a Fabric lakehouse. The data already has the required structure and no transformations are needed. Which option should you choose?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Notebooks are better for transformation workloads.
Incorrect. Transformations are not required.
Correct. Copy activity efficiently transfers data without transformations.
Incorrect. Querysets are used for querying.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Copy activity is the simplest and most cost-effective method for direct ingestion.

questions.Question: A semantic model refresh currently processes three years of data and takes more than three hours. Only new and modified records should be refreshed. What should you implement?

Options.reason: Correct. Incremental refresh processes only changed partitions.
Incorrect. This does not automatically reduce refresh scope.
Incorrect. Service-managed incremental refresh is preferred.
Incorrect. They do not optimize refresh scope.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Incremental refresh allows only new and updated data partitions to be processed.

questions.Question: A Delta table contains thousands of very small Parquet files. Queries are slow and storage costs are increasing. Which maintenance action should you perform?

Options.reason: Incorrect. VACUUM removes old files but does not compact active files.
Correct. OPTIMIZE compacts files and VACUUM removes obsolete data.
Incorrect. This can damage Delta table consistency.
Incorrect. This does not solve the file fragmentation issue.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: OPTIMIZE improves performance by compacting files while VACUUM removes obsolete storage.

questions.Question: You have a fact table containing 500 million rows. Most queries use aggregated data, but some users need transaction-level details. Which storage mode should the detailed fact table use in a user-defined aggregation design?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Detailed tables in aggregation designs typically remain DirectQuery.
Incorrect. Dual mode is typically used for dimensions.
Correct. Aggregation patterns require the detailed table to remain DirectQuery.
Incorrect. This is not the recommended answer for user-defined aggregations.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: The detailed fact table should remain DirectQuery while aggregated tables are imported.

questions.Question: A DirectQuery report sends excessive queries to the source database whenever users change slicers. You need to reduce the number of database requests. What should you do?

Options.reason: Incorrect. This can increase query activity.

Options.text: Add Top N filters to every visual
Options.reason: Incorrect. This does not reduce query frequency.
Incorrect. Visual type does not solve the issue.

Options.text: Use Apply buttons for filters and slicers
Options.reason: Correct. Apply buttons delay execution until selections are finalized.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Apply buttons consolidate user selections into fewer database requests and improve DirectQuery performance.

questions.Question: You need to model sales data that contains multiple fact tables sharing common dimensions. Which schema design should you implement?

Options.reason: Correct. A star schema provides optimal performance and usability for analytical workloads.
Incorrect. Flat tables often increase redundancy and model size.
Incorrect. Network schemas are not recommended for Fabric semantic models.
Incorrect. Hierarchical structures do not address shared dimensions effectively.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Star schemas simplify relationships, improve performance, and are the recommended modeling approach for Fabric semantic models.

questions.Question: A dimension table contains duplicate business keys. You need to ensure each row can be uniquely identified in the semantic model. What should you add?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Measures do not uniquely identify rows.
Correct. Surrogate keys provide unique row identifiers.
Incorrect. Hierarchies organize attributes but do not enforce uniqueness.
Incorrect. Calculation groups do not identify rows.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Surrogate keys provide stable, unique identifiers for dimension records.

questions.Question: Users need to analyze sales by year, quarter, month, and day. Which feature should you configure?

Options.reason: Incorrect. RLS controls data access.
Incorrect. Perspectives simplify model views.
Correct. Date hierarchies support drill-down analysis.
Incorrect. Aggregations improve performance.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Date hierarchies provide intuitive navigation across time-based levels.

questions.Question: You need to reduce semantic model size while maintaining report functionality. Which action should you take first?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Capacity does not reduce model size.
Correct. Removing unnecessary columns directly reduces storage requirements.
Incorrect. Measures generally do not reduce model size.
Incorrect. Incremental refresh affects refresh performance.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Removing unused columns is one of the most effective ways to reduce semantic model size.

questions.Question: A dimension table must filter multiple fact tables. Which relationship cardinality is most appropriate?

Options.reason: Correct. One dimension row typically relates to many fact rows.
Incorrect. Many-to-many should be avoided when possible.
Incorrect. Fact tables rarely have one-to-one relationships with dimensions.
Incorrect. Filtering requires relationships.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: One-to-many relationships are the standard design pattern between dimensions and facts.

questions.Question: Which DAX function returns the total sales from the beginning of the year through the current context date?

Options.reason: Correct. TOTALYTD calculates cumulative year-to-date values.
Incorrect. SUMX iterates over a table.
Incorrect. RANKX calculates rankings.
Incorrect. DISTINCTCOUNT counts unique values.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: TOTALYTD is specifically designed for year-to-date calculations.

questions.Question: You need a measure that evaluates an expression after modifying filter context. Which DAX function should you use?

Options.reason: Incorrect. RELATED retrieves values from related tables.
Correct. CALCULATE modifies filter context before evaluation.
Incorrect. COUNTROWS counts table rows.
Incorrect. VALUES returns distinct values.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: CALCULATE is the primary DAX function for context transition and filter modification.

questions.Question: A measure should ignore report filters applied to the Product table while retaining all other filters. Which function should you use?

Options.reason: Incorrect. KEEPFILTERS preserves filters.
Incorrect. USERELATIONSHIP activates inactive relationships.
Correct. REMOVEFILTERS clears filters from specified tables or columns.
Incorrect. LOOKUPVALUE retrieves matching values.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: REMOVEFILTERS selectively removes filters while preserving the remaining filter context.

questions.Question: You need to rank products by total revenue within each category. Which DAX function is most appropriate?

Options.reason: Correct. RANKX calculates rankings over a specified table.
Incorrect. FILTER returns a filtered table.
Incorrect. TOPN returns top rows but does not assign rankings.
Incorrect. AVERAGEX calculates averages.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: RANKX is designed specifically for ranking calculations.

questions.Question: Which DAX function returns the value of an expression evaluated for each row of a table and then sums the results?

Options.reason: Incorrect. SUM only aggregates a column.
Correct. SUMX iterates row by row and aggregates the results.
Incorrect. COUNTX counts values.
Incorrect. MAXX returns the highest value.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: SUMX is an iterator function that evaluates an expression for each row.

questions.Question: You need to restrict users so they can only view rows belonging to their assigned sales territory. Which feature should you implement?

Options.reason: Incorrect. OLS hides tables or columns.
Incorrect. Workspace roles control permissions.
Correct. RLS filters rows based on user context.
Incorrect. Labels classify data.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: RLS is used to restrict access to specific rows of data.

questions.Question: A table contains salary information that must be hidden from report authors while remaining available for calculations. Which feature should you use?

Options.reason: Correct. OLS hides objects from users.
Incorrect. RLS filters rows.
Incorrect. Refresh settings do not control visibility.
Incorrect. Pipelines support release management.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: OLS hides tables and columns from users while preserving model functionality.

questions.Question: You need to classify a report containing personally identifiable information. Which capability should you use?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Deployment rules manage environment changes.
Correct. Sensitivity labels classify and protect data.
Incorrect. Perspectives simplify model views.
Incorrect. Bookmarks save report states.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: Sensitivity labels help classify and govern sensitive information.

questions.Question: A user must be able to publish reports and manage workspace content. Which workspace role should you assign?

Options.reason: Incorrect. Viewers have read-only access.
Incorrect. Contributors cannot manage all workspace settings.
Correct. Members can create, publish, and manage content.
Incorrect. Access is required.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: The Member role provides broad content management capabilities.

questions.Question: You need to test row-level security behavior for a specific user before deployment. Which capability should you use?

Options.reason: Correct. View As simulates user security contexts.
Incorrect. Analyze in Excel does not simulate security roles.
Incorrect. Performance Analyzer measures query execution.
Incorrect. Lineage view tracks dependencies.

questions.CorrectAnswerExplanation: View As allows validation of RLS and role behavior before publishing.
